quote: Travel tears down the walls that ignorance puts up.
author: Rick Steves

quote: Not all those who wander are lost.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quote: Travel makes one modest. You see what a tiny place you occupy in the world.
author: Gustav Flaubert

quote: If we were meant to stay in one place, we'd have roots instead of feet.
author: Rachel Wolchin

quote: I love places that make you realise how tiny you and your problems are.
author: Anonymous

quote: I travel because I become uncomfortable being too comfortable.
author: Carew Papritz

quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: To travel is to take a journey into yourself.
author: Danny Kaye

quote: Don't be that person who is too busy when you are young and then too tired when you are old.
author: Anonymous

quote: Wherever you go becomes a part of you somehow.
author: Anita Desai

quote: Travel is the only thing you buy that makes you richer.
author: Anonymous

quote: A great way to learn about your country is to leave it.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Don't let fear get in the way of the life you are meant to live.
author: Anonymous

quote: Little by little, one travels far.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quote: Once the travel bug bites, there is no known antidote, and I know that I shall be happily infected until the end of my life.
author: Michael Palin

quote: I'm in love with cities I've never been to and people I've never met.
author: Melody Truong

quote: If you never go, you will never know.
author: Anonymous

quote: With age comes wisdom. With travel comes understanding.
author: Sandra Lake

quote: Life begins at the end of your comfort zone.
author: Neale Donald Walsch

quote: Live life with no excuses, travel with no regret.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Travel is an investment in yourself.
author: Matthew Karsten

quote: The goal in life is to die with memories, not dreams.
author: Anonymous

quote: Don't listen to what they say, go see with your own eyes.
author: Anonymous

quote: Of all the books in the world, the best stories are found between the pages of a passport.
author: Anonymous

quote: To travel is to discover that everyone is wrong about other countries.
author: Aldous Huxley

quote: Twenty years from now, you will be more disappointed by the things you didn't do than by the ones you did.
author: Mark Twain

quote: In the end, we only regret the chances we didn't take.
author: Lewis Carroll

quote: Dare to live the life you've always wanted.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: For my part, I travel not to go anywhere, but to go. I travel for travel's sake. The great affair is to move.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: There was nowhere to go but everywhere, so just keep on rolling under the stars.
author: Jack Kerouac

quote: Travelling – it leaves you speechless, then turns you into a storyteller.
author: Ibn Battuta (Maghrebi traveller, explorer and scholar)

quote: A mind that is stretched by a new experience can never go back to its old dimensions.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr.

quote: Travel with an open heart and an open mind, then the world will reveal its beauty to you.
author: Ibn Battuta (Maghrebi traveller, explorer and scholar)

quote: The world's big, and I want to have a good look at it before it gets dark.
author: John Muir

quote: The real voyage of discovery consists not in seeking new landscapes but in having new eyes.
author: Marcel Proust

quote: Travel is never a matter of money but of courage.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: Travel is more than the seeing of sights; it is a change that goes on, deep and permanent, in the ideas of living.
author: Miriam Beard

quote: Man cannot discover new oceans unless he has the courage to lose sight of the shore.
author: Andre Gide

quote: Great things never came from comfort zones.
author: Anonymous

quote: Some people are so poor, all they have is money.
author: Patrick Meagher / Bob Marley

quote: I was always scared to travel alone, but once I took that first step, I realized I was unstoppable.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quote: At first, I was afraid to travel solo, but then I discovered that the only thing I was truly afraid of was missing out on life.
author: Anonymous

quote: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
author: Oprah Winfrey

quote: Do you really want to look back on your life and see how wonderful it could have been had you not been afraid to live it?
author: Caroline Myss

quote: To awaken quite alone in a strange town is one of the most pleasant sensations in the world. You are surrounded by adventure.
author: Freya Stark

quote: When you're traveling with someone, you share each discovery. But when you are alone, you have to carry each experience with you like a secret, something you have to write on your heart because there's no other way to preserve it.
author: Shauna Niequist

quote: Traveling solo allowed me to write the chapters of my life with every step I took.
author: Anonymous

quote: Travel opens your heart, broadens your mind, and fills your life with stories to tell.
author: Anonymous

quote: We wander for distraction, but we travel for fulfilment.
author: Hilaire Belloc

quote: Do not follow where the path may lead. Go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
author: John A. Shedd

quote: The traveller sees what he sees, the tourist sees what he has come to see.
author: G.K. Chesterton

quote: Wandering re-establishes the original harmony which once existed between man and the universe.
author: Anatole France

quote: If you think adventure is dangerous, try routine; it's lethal.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: A man of ordinary talent will always be ordinary, whether he travels or not; but a man of superior talent will go to pieces if he remains forever in the same place.
author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

quote: To my mind, the greatest reward and luxury of travel is to be able to experience everyday things as if for the first time, to be in a position in which almost nothing is so familiar it is taken for granted.
author: Bill Bryson

quote: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quote: Traveling is not something you're good at. It's something you do. Like breathing.
author: Gayle Forman

quote: If you don't go after what you want, you'll never have it. If you don't ask, the answer is always no. If you don't step forward, you are always in the same place.
author: Nora Roberts

quote: And once you live a good story, you get a taste for a kind of meaning in life, and you can't go back to being normal; you can't go back to meaningless scenes stitched together by the unforgettable thread of wasted time.
author: Donald Miller

quote: I do not want to get to the end of my life and find that I just lived the length of it. I want to have lived the width of it as well.
author: Diane Ackerman

quote: All journeys have secret destinations of which the traveler is unaware.
author: Martin Buber

quote: Tourists don't know where they've been, travelers don't know where they're going.
author: Paul Theroux

quote: There is no moment of delight in any pilgrimage like the beginning of it.
author: Charles Dudley Warner

quote: Once you have traveled, the voyage never ends, but is played out over and over again in the quiestest chambers. The mind can never break off from the journey.
author: Pat Conroy

quote: Like all great travelers, I have seen more than I remember, and remember more than I have seen.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: I soon realized that no journey carries one far unless, as it extends into the world around us, it goes an equal distance into the world within.
author: Lillian Smith

quote: He who is outside his door has the hardest part of his journey behind him.
author: Dutch Proverb

quote: I see my path, but I don't know where it leads. Not knowing where I'm going is what inspires me to travel it.
author: Rosalia de Castro

quote: You don't choose the day you enter the world and you don't chose the day you leave. It's what you do in between that makes all the difference.
author: Anita Septimus

quote: The whole object of travel is not to set foot on foreign land; it is at last to set foot on one's own country as a foreign land.
author: G.K. Chesterton

quote: Why do you go away? So that you can come back. So that you can see the place you came from with new eyes and extra colors. And the people there see you differently, too. Coming back to where you started is not the same as never leaving.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: There is a difference between knowing the path and walking the path.
author: The Matrix (movie)

quote: No matter how much you try, you'll end up missing out on something, so it's better to enjoy the time you currently have.
author: Yeh Jawani Hai Deewani (movie)

quote: In order to reach somewhere better, you need to leave behind something—even if it is comfortable.
author: Yeh Jawani Hai Deewani (movie)

quote: Your heart is free, have the courage to follow it.
author: Braveheart (movie)

quote: You only have one life. It's actually your duty to live it as fully as possible.
author: Me Before You (movie)

quote: A life lived in fear, is a life half-lived.
author: Strictly Ballroom (movie)

quote: I was amazed that what I needed to survive could be carried on my back. And, most surprising of all, that I could carry it.
author: Cheryl Strayed, Wild: From Lost to Found on the Pacific Crest Trail

quote: If you walk the footsteps of a stranger, you'll learn things you never knew you never knew.
author: Pocahontas (movie)

quote: If you don't know where you want to go, then it doesn't matter which path you take.
author: Alice in Wonderland (movie)

quote: Life is a journey to be experienced, not a problem to be solved.
author: Winnie The Pooh

quote: If you focus on what you left behind, you will never see what lies ahead.
author: Ratatouille (movie)

quote: It's up to you how far you'll go. If you don't try, you'll never know.
author: The Sword In The Stone (movie)

quote: The moment you doubt whether you can fly, you cease forever to be able to do it.
author: Peter Pan

quote: Life's not a spectator sport. If watchin' is all you're gunna do, then you're gunna watch your life go by without ya.
author: The Hunchback of Notre Dame (movie)

quote: Yeah, you're going to die. It's a matter of time. That ain't the question. The question is whether they're going to have a good story to tell about you when you're gone.
author: The Peanut Butter Falcon (movie)

quote: Most people don't have the luxury of just leaving it all behind.
author: The Way (movie)

quote: To choose doubt as a philosophy of life is akin to choosing immobility as a means of transportation.
author: The Life of Pi (movie)

quote: The absolute simplicity. That's what I love. When you're climbing, your mind is clear and free from all confusions. You have focus. And suddenly the light becomes sharper, the sounds are richer, and you're filled with the deep, powerful presence of life.
author: Seven Years in Tibet (movie)

quote: Life is not the amount of breaths you take. It's the moments that take your breath away.
author: Hitch (movie)

quote: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
author: Walt Disney

quote: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
author: Walt Disney

quote: We keep moving forward, opening new doors, and doing new things, because we're curious and curiosity keeps leading us down new paths.
author: Walt Disney

quote: First, think. Second, believe. Third, dream. And finally, dare.
author: Walt Disney

quote: Jobs fill your pocket, but adventures fill your soul.
author: Jamie Lyn Beatty

quote: Never hesitate to go far away, beyond all seas, all frontiers, all countries, all beliefs.
author: Amin Maalouf

quote: Stop worrying about the potholes in the road and celebrate the journey.
author: Fitzhugh Mullan

quote: If you wish to travel far and fast, travel light. Take off all your envies, jealousies, unforgiveness, selfishness and fears.
author: Cesare Pavese

quote: It is only in adventure that some people succeed in knowing themselves – in finding themselves.
author: Andre Gide

quote: We travel not to escape life, but for life not to escape us.
author: Anonymous

quote: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness.
author: Mark Twain

quote: If you reject the food, ignore the customs, fear the religion, and avoid the people, you’d be better staying at home.
author: James Michener

quote: If you don’t know where you’re going, any road will get you there.
author: Lewis Carroll

quote: Only one who wanders finds new paths.
author: Norwegian proverb

quote: The further I go, the closer to me I get.
author: Andrew McCarthy

quote: It is not the destination where you end up but the mishaps and memories you create along the way.
author: Penelope Riley

quote: Who lives sees much. Who travels sees more.
author: Arab Proverb

quote: I wasn’t just collecting stamps; I was collecting pieces of myself, scattered across borders and cultures.
author: Monkey on the Roads

quote: The distance between your dreams and reality is called action.
author: Brian Tracy

quote: If we try and fail, we have temporary disappointments. But if we do not try at all, we have permanent regrets.
author: Bernard Williams

quote: If you want something you have never had, you must be willing to do something you have never done.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: The greatest pleasure in life is doing what people say you cannot do.
author: Walter Bagehot

quote: Go ahead and do the impossible. It’s worth the look on the faces of those who said you couldn’t.
author: Walter Bagehot

quote: Never give up on a dream just because of the time it will take to accomplish it. The time will pass anyway.
author: Earl Nightingale

quote: You don’t have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
author: Zig Ziglar

quote: A river cuts through rock, not because of its power, but because of its persistence.
author: Jim Watkins

quote: If it is important to you, you will find a way. If not, you’ll find an excuse.
author: Ryan Blair

quote: I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
author: C.G. Jung

quote: You are what you do, not what you say you’ll do.
author: C.G. Jung

quote: Your visions will become clear only when you can look into your own heart. Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.
author: C.G. Jung

quote: An entire sea of water can’t sink a ship unless it gets inside the ship. Similarly, the negativity of the world can’t put you down unless you allow it to get inside you.
author: Goi Nasu

quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
author: Confucius

quote: If you want to live a happy life, tie it to a goal, not to people or things.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
author: Suzy Kassem

quote: Knowing is not enough, we must apply. Willing is not enough, we must do.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: The first step to getting anywhere is deciding you’re no longer willing to stay where you are.
author: Anonymous

quote: A year from now you may wish you had started today.
author: Karen Lamb

quote: If you don’t make the time to work on creating the life you want, you’re eventually going to be forced to spend a lot of time dealing with a life you don’t want.
author: Kevin Ngo

author: Muhammad Ali

quote: When you want to succeed as bad as you want to breathe, then you’ll be successful.
author: Eric Thomas

quote: Change of any sort requires courage.
author: Mary Anne Radmacher

quote: Turn your face to the sun and the shadows fall behind you.
author: Maori Proverbs

quote: If you don’t build your dream someone will hire you to help build theirs.
author: Tony Gaskins

quote: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Believe you can and you’re halfway there.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Courage is not having the strength to go on; it is going on when you don’t have the strength.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: In any moment of decision, the best thing you can do is the right thing, the next best thing is the wrong thing, and the worst thing you can do is nothing.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Courage doesn’t always roar. Sometimes courage is the little voice at the end of the day that says I’ll try again tomorrow.
author: Mary Anne Radmacher

quote: What would you do if you weren’t afraid?
author: Sheryl Sandberg

quote: I don’t count my sit-ups. I only start counting when it starts hurting. When I feel pain, that’s when I start counting, because that’s when it really counts.
author: Muhammad Ali

quote: It’s better to regret trying and failing than to regret not trying at all.
author: Aneko Yusagi

quote: If you want to hate the world, watch the news. If you want to love the world, travel it.
author: Anonymous

quote: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later.
author: Og Mandino

quote: A goal without a plan is just a wish.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quote: Life isn’t about waiting for the storm to pass…It’s about learning to dance in the rain.
author: Vivian Greene

quote: Don’t call it a dream call it a plan.
author: Anonymous

quote: A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: I am not a product of my circumstances. I am a product of my decisions.
author: Stephen R. Covey

quote: The pessimist sees difficulty in every opportunity. The optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: Life is either a daring adventure or nothing.
author: Helen Keller

quote: Life is 10% what happens to you and 90% of how you react to it.
author: Charles Swindoll

quote: The most common way people give up their power is by thinking they don’t have any.
author: Alice Walker

quote: If you cannot do great things, do small things in a great way.
author: Napoleon Hill

quote: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
author: Zig Ziglar

quote: Don’t let the negativity given to you by the world disempower you. Instead give to yourself that which empowers you.
author: Les Brown

quote: The more you praise and celebrate your life, the more there is in life to celebrate.
author: Oprah Winfrey

quote: We delight in the beauty of the butterfly, but rarely admit the changes it has gone through to achieve that beauty.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: I can be changed by what happens to me. But I refuse to be reduced by it.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive; and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: You may encounter many defeats, but you must not be defeated. In fact, it may be necessary to encounter the defeats, so you can know who you are, what you can rise from, how you can still come out of it.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Trust yourself. Create the kind of self that you will be happy to live with all your life.
author: Golda Meir

quote: With realization of one’s own potential and self-confidence in one’s ability, one can build a better world.
author: Dalai Lama

quote: Confidence comes not from always being right but from not fearing to be wrong.
author: Peter T. Mcintyre

quote: If you hear a voice within you say ‘you cannot paint,’ then by all means paint, and that voice will be silenced.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: Strong people have a strong sense of self-worth and self-awareness; they don’t need the approval of others.
author: Roy T. Bennett

quote: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: You’re braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
author: Winnie The Pooh

quote: There is no passion to be found playing small – in settling for a life that is less than the one you are capable of living.
author: Nelson Mandela

quote: Life is short, the world is wide, I wanna make some memories.
author: Mamma Mia! (movie)

quote: Make your lives a masterpiece, you only get one canvas.
author: E.A. Bucchianeri

quote: We only have one life and one body to care of, and we better do it right. You never know what tomorrow may bring and so we better live this life the best we can and be grateful for everything we have.
author: Novak Djokovic

quote: Life is short, break the rules, forgive quickly, kiss slowly. love truly, laugh uncontrollably, and never regret anything that makes you smile.
author: Mark Twain

quote: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough
author: Mae West

quote: The quality, not the longevity, of one’s life is what is important.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Life’s tragedy is that we get old too soon and wise too late.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: Life moves pretty fast. If you don’t stop and look around once in a while you could miss it.
author: Ferris Bueller

quote: You’re only here for a short visit. Don’t hurry, don’t worry. And be sure to smell the flowers along the way.
author: Walter Hagen

quote: Life is too short to be reading quotes about life being too short. Stop reading and go live your life!
author: Kevin Ngo

quote: One day your life will flash before your eyes. Make sure it’s worth watching.
author: Gerard Way

quote: I’d rather attempt to do something great and fail than to attempt to do nothing and succeed.
author: Robert H. Schuller

quote: Things work out best for those who make the best of the way things work out.
author: John Wooden

quote: If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
author: Wayne Dyer

quote: Why do we close our eyes when we pray, cry, dream or kiss? Because we know that the most beautiful things in life are not seen, but felt by the heart.
author: Anne Sullivan

quote: Take one day at a time. Today, after all, is the tomorrow you worried about yesterday.
author: Billy Graham

quote: Never get tired of doing little things for others. Sometimes, those little things occupy the biggest part of their hearts.
author: Anonymous

quote: When writing the story of your life, don’t let anyone else hold the pen.
author: Harley Davidson

quote: Difficulty calls us to rise up. And in that rising, we learn what we are capable of.
author: Carli Baum

quote: Strength does not come from winning. Your struggles develop your strengths. When you go through hardships and decide not to surrender, that is strength.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: I survived because the fire inside me burned brighter than the fire around me.
author: Joshua Graham

quote: Remember: Every champion was once a contender that refused to give up.
author: Rocky Balboa

quote: Nothing can dim the light that shines from within.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Strength does not come from what you can do. It comes from overcoming the things you thought you couldn’t.
author: Anonymous

quote: Never trust your fears; they don’t know your strength.
author: Athena Singh

quote: Go as long as you can, and then take another step.
author: Anonymous

quote: I'm not stopping when I'm tired. I'm stopping when I'm done.
author: David Goggins

quote: If you don’t fit into a certain type, there’s a lot of strength in just being who you are.
author: Kim Gordon

quote: What other people think of me is not my business. What I do is what I do. How people see me doesn’t change what I decide to do.
author: Ru Paul

quote: Your present circumstances don’t determine where you can go. They merely determine where you start.
author: Nido Qubein

quote: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
author: C.S. Lewis

quote: It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy; not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
author: Dan Millman

quote: If you’re brave enough to say goodbye, life will reward you with a new hello.
author: Paulo Coehlo

quote: What a wonderful thought it is that some of the best days of our lives haven’t even happened yet.
author: Anne Frank

quote: It always seems impossible until it’s done.
author: Nelson Mandela

quote: Never underestimate the power you have to take your life in a new direction.
author: Germany Kent

quote: You don’t have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Life doesn’t get easier or more forgiving, we get stronger and more resilient.
author: Steve Maraboli

quote: Do the best you can until you know better. Then, when you know better, do better.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: No matter what anybody tells you, words and ideas can change the world.
author: Robin Williams

quote: Don’t try so hard to fit in, and certainly don’t try so hard to be different… just try hard to be you.
author: Zendaya Coleman

quote: There are going to be ups and downs, but if you try to finish what you’ve started, to get outside your comfort zone and stay positive, that’ll help you feel good about yourself and find the mental toughness you need to keep going.
author: Andre De Grasse

quote: Don’t measure your value with someone else’s tape.
author: Anonymous

quote: Not all storms come to disrupt your life, some come to clean your path.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: Stop shrinking to fit into places you’ve outgrown.
author: Furaha Joyce

quote: Men trip not on mountains, they stumble upon stones
author: Esquie | Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 (game)

quote: To move, to breathe, to fly, to float, To gain all while you give, To roam the roads of lands remote, To travel is to live.
author: Hans Christian Andersen

quote: The mountains are calling and I must go.
author: John Muir

quote: It’s not down on a map, true places never are.
author: Herman Melville

quote: Travel light, live light, spread the light, be the light.
author: Yogi Bhajan

quote: Sometimes the most scenic roads in life are the detours you didn’t mean to take.
author: Angela N. Blount

quote: Be brave enough to live the life of your dreams according to your vision and purpose instead of the expectations and opinions of others.
author: Roy T. Bennett

quote: Take vacations. Go as many places as you can. Whenever you can. You can always make money. You can’t always make memories.
author: Anonymous

quote: What you’ve done becomes the judge of what you’re going to do – especially in other people’s minds. When you’re traveling, you are what you are right there and then. People don’t have your past to hold against you. No yesterdays on the road.
author: William Least Heat Moon

quote: It’s a dangerous business, Frodo, going out your door. You step onto the road, and if you don’t keep your feet, there’s no knowing where you might be swept off to.
author: J.R.R Tolkien

quote: Don’t be afraid to fail. Be afraid not to try.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: Do not stop thinking of life as an adventure. You have no security unless you can live bravely, excitingly, imaginatively; unless you can choose a challenge instead of competence.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quote: We live in a wonderful world that is full of beauty, charm and adventure. There is no end to the adventures that we can have if only we seek them with our eyes open.
author: Jawaharlal Nehru

quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: I want to be where the sun warms the sky.
author: Madonna

quote: We travel, initially, to lose ourselves. We travel, next, to find ourselves.
author: Pico Iyer

quote: Every man can transform the world from one of monotony and drabness to one of excitement and adventure.
author: Irving Wallace

quote: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I—I took the one less traveled by, and that has made all the difference.
author: Robert Frost

quote: Attitude is the difference between an ordeal and an adventure.
author: Bob Bitchin

quote: The danger of an adventure is worth a thousand days of ease and comfort.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: If happiness is the goal – and it should be, then adventures should be top priority.
author: Richard Branson

quote: The man who goes alone can start today, but he who travels with another must wait till that other is ready.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: Every man’s life ends the same way. It is only the details of how he lived and how he died that distinguish one man from another.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: Fill your life with adventures, not things. Have stories to tell not stuff to show.
author: Anonymous

quote: To my mind, the greatest reward and luxury of travel is to be able to experience everyday things as if for the first time, to be in a position in which almost nothing is so familiar it is taken for granted.
author: Bill Bryson

quote: You must go on adventures to find out where you truly belong.
author: Sue Fitzmaurice

quote: Life should not be a journey to the grave with the intention of arriving safely in a pretty and well preserved body, but rather to skid in broadside in a cloud of smoke, thoroughly used up, totally worn out, and loudly proclaiming “Wow! What a Ride!”
author: Hunter S Thompson

quote: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion.
author: Albert Camers

quote: Travel is the great leveler, the great teacher, bitter as medicine, crueler than mirror-glass. A long stretch of road will teach you more about yourself than a hundred years of quiet introspection.
author: Patrick Rothfuss

quote: A positive attitude gives you power over your circumstances instead of your circumstances having power over you.
author: Joyce Meyer

quote: The world is big and I’d like to have a good look before it gets dark.
author: John Muir

quote: It is not the mountain we conquer, but ourselves.
author: Sir Edmund Hillary

quote: Only those who risk going too far can possibly find out how far they can go.
author: T.S Eliott

quote: Don’t die without embracing the daring adventure your life was meant to be.
author: Steve Pavlina

quote: When a man is a traveller, the world is his house and the sky is his roof, where he hangs his hat is his home, and all the people are his family.
author: Drew Bundini Brown

quote: Travel far enough, you meet yourself.
author: David Mitchell

quote: May your adventures bring you closer together, even as they take you far away from home.
author: Trenton Lee Stewart

quote: It feels good to be lost in the right direction.
author: Anonymous

quote: Life was made for good friends and great adventure
author: Anonymous

quote: I hope you live a life you’re proud of. If you find that you’re not, I hope you have the strength to start all over again.
author: Eric Roth, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

quote: See the line where the sky meets the sea? It calls me. And no one knows, how far it goes. If the wind in my sail on the sea stays behind me, One day I’ll know, how far I’ll go.
author: Moana

quote: The world is not in your books and maps, it’s out there.
author: J.R.R Tolkien

quote: I would rather own little and see the world than own the world and see little of it.
author: Alexander Sattler

quote: It’s a big and beautiful world. Most of us live and die in the same corner where we were born and never get to see any of it. I don’t want to be most of us.
author: Oberyon Martell

quote: The potential for adventure makes life worth living.
author: Vicki Garside

quote: Add life to your days, not days to your life.
author: Anonymous

quote: Adventure is allowing the unexpected to happen to you. Exploration is experiencing what you have not experienced before.
author: Richard Aldington

quote: It’s a funny thing coming home. Nothing changes. Everything looks the same, feels the same, even smells the same. You realize what’s changed, is you.
author: Eric Roth, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

quote: Life can only be understood looking backward. It must be lived forward.
author: Eric Roth, The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

quote: Difficulties in life are intended to make us better, not bitter.
author: John C. Maxwell

quote: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

quote: The only way to achieve the impossible is to believe it is possible.
author: Charles Kingsleigh, Alice in Wonderland

quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don’t take.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: Be a first-rate version of yourself, not a second-rate version of someone else.
author: Judy Garland

quote: If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
author: Booker T. Washington

quote: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
author: Peter Drucker

quote: Hard work beats talent when talent doesn’t work hard.
author: Tim Notke

quote: First step to success? Decide you’re ready to grow beyond what you think is possible.
author: Anonymous

quote: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: Your comfort zone is a beautiful place, but nothing ever grows there.
author: Anonymous

quote: People’s limited perceptions of you don’t define your potential.
author: Anonymous
